title: EPFL School of Life Sciences Summer Research Program
about: Eight-week summer research program at the EPFL School of Life Sciences, July 5 to August 27, 2027, for students enrolled in a life sciences field with a minimum GPA equivalent to 3.75/4.0 or top 5% of class.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Eight-week summer research program" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"students enrolled in a life sciences field" (research projects) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
